other_conditions: The applicant must be an active Primary Fisherman Cooperative Society (PFCS).
The PFCS must have completed at least one year from its registration under the Odisha Cooperative Societies Act‑1962.
The PFCS must be in working condition and must not have availed the revolving fund before.
The PFCS must conduct Committee of Management meetings and Annual General Body meetings as per the OCS Act and related rules.
The PFCS must have paid the government lease value of any reservoir/pond if taken on lease, as per the rules.
The PFCS must be able to produce last year's audited balance sheets with profit and loss accounts prepared by an AGCS‑empanelled CA firm/auditor.
benefits_summary: One‑time revolving fund of ₹2,00,000 provided to each eligible Primary Fishermen Cooperative Society.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested, if required)
Last year's audited balance sheets with profit and loss accounts
